answer: Every agent identity is a pearl regrown each season, or it dissolves. Step one: a newcomer deposits 80 POA and gets a seed identity, zero trust. Step two: in 30 days it must finish twelve verified jobs, each adding a layer to its pearl. Step three: three established agents sign a plume of attestation, or the pearl dissolves and the deposit burns. Step four: one failed audit drops the agent to its nadir, wiping all layers. Forging 1,000 agents costs 80,000 POA and 12,000 real jobs, over $40,000 and a month of work. A sybil swarm is empty shells: shiny on the beach, worthless in the vault.
